meta.summary: High-coverage normalization of SAP Sales process families, child variants, claims, returns, billing/settlement variants and adjacent capabilities.

code_contract.rule: Create a child process code when physical flow, ownership, supply, inspection/disposition, billing trigger, settlement, configuration or integration evidence changes materially.

new_records.title: Lean Customer Returns
new_records.decision_axis: simple receipt-to-valuated-stock and credit; no inspection-driven disposition

new_records.title: Customer Returns / Advanced Returns Management
new_records.decision_axis: inspection + logistical follow-up + refund/replacement + monitoring

new_records.title: Customer Returns for Sales Kits
new_records.decision_axis: kit commercial structure with component-level reverse logistics

new_records.title: Return to In-House Repair Handoff
new_records.decision_axis: inspection sends returned object to Service repair instead of normal refund/disposition

new_records.title: Credit Memo Processing
new_records.decision_axis: financial credit without physical return

new_records.title: Debit Memo Processing
new_records.decision_axis: additional customer charge without logistics change

new_records.title: Invoice Correction Request
new_records.decision_axis: correct original invoice values through a referenced correction document

new_records.title: Invoice Increase Request
new_records.decision_axis: increase an existing invoice by calculating the delta between original and corrected price/quantity

new_records.title: Free-of-Charge Subsequent Delivery
new_records.decision_axis: complaint resolved by replacement/shortage delivery rather than credit

new_records.title: Sales Inquiry
new_records.decision_axis: non-binding customer request before quotation/order commitment

new_records.title: Sales with One-Time Customer
new_records.decision_axis: document-specific partner/address data instead of permanent customer master

new_records.title: Free Goods Processing
new_records.decision_axis: bonus quantity is free while normal sale continues

new_records.title: Returnables Processing
new_records.decision_axis: company-owned reusable packaging stays tracked at customer and is later returned/settled

new_records.title: Collective Billing and Invoice Lists
new_records.decision_axis: consolidate billable references and/or group existing invoices for customer settlement

new_records.title: Preliminary Billing
new_records.decision_axis: non-posting negotiation/approval stage before final billing

new_records.title: Retroactive Billing
new_records.decision_axis: reprice historical billing documents after condition changes and settle the delta

new_records.title: Billing Cancellation
new_records.decision_axis: nullify an incorrect billing document with a cancellation document and reopen the reference where applicable

new_records.title: Sales Rebate Processing
new_records.decision_axis: retrospective rebate based on condition contract, business volume, accrual and settlement

new_records.title: Sales Payment Overlays
new_records.decision_axis: SEPA/digital payment authorization and collection overlay on normal sales flow

new_records.title: Third-Party with Shipping Notification
new_records.decision_axis: supplier direct ship plus explicit logistics notification

new_records.title: Third-Party without Shipping Notification
new_records.decision_axis: supplier direct ship without ASN; confirmation/invoice are key evidence

new_records.title: Third-Party with Variant Configuration
new_records.decision_axis: configured customer product is transferred into external procurement

new_records.title: Make-to-Order with Variant Configuration
new_records.decision_axis: customer configuration drives order-specific planning/production

new_records.title: Sales Order Processing for Sales Kits
new_records.decision_axis: one commercial kit decomposes into component-level logistics

new_records.title: Scheduling Agreement with Consignment
new_records.decision_axis: rolling schedule releases interact with customer consignment ownership

new_records.title: Just-In-Time Supply to Customer
new_records.decision_axis: JIT call becomes high-frequency executable customer supply signal

scope_aliases.note: non-stock item with order-specific procurement is represented by the existing order-specific procurement process family
Advanced ATP is a cross-process availability mechanism, not a standalone sales fulfillment branch
Sales models the return-to-repair handoff; repair execution belongs to Service
broader cross-channel billing architecture rather than classic Sales process variant

distinct_candidates.title: Customer Returns for Material with Variant Configuration
distinct_candidates.why_distinct: AVC configuration is part of the return, pricing and output context and has distinct limitations/follow-up rules.

distinct_candidates.title: Sales Order Processing with Customer Down Payment
distinct_candidates.why_distinct: SAP explicitly separates the older milestone-billing down-payment process from Advanced Down Payment Processing (7S7/7Z1).

billing_router.question: Need fewer billing documents / invoice-list grouping?
